title: Recording: Ram by Paul and Linda McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio A-1, A&R Recording, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Dixon Van Winkle

Paul and Linda McCartney continued work on the Ram album on 25 February 1971.

This was the fourth of five sessions in the week at A&R Recording in New York City. The details of the songs recorded on this day are not known.

Page last updated: 25 February 2026
